This is a deeply concerning and serious situation. If you believe a child is being drugged or is in any immediate danger, please contact emergency services or your local child protective services immediately. The child's physical safety must be the absolute first priority, and authorities have the resources to intervene and investigate claims of abuse. 

To address the custody interference and the therapist's actions, it is crucial to consult with a family law attorney. A lawyer can help you navigate the legal system, request court-ordered evaluations, and protect your visitation rights. Additionally, if a therapist is acting unethically or illegally, you or your attorney can file a formal complaint with their state licensing board so they can be properly investigated. Please reach out to legal and child welfare professionals who can take immediate action to protect the child and guide you through this complex process.
